extracted.name: Pineapple smoothie
extracted.description: Blend fresh pineapple and banana with lime juice to make this tangy pineapple smoothie. It's great for breakfast and kids will love it too
instruction_lines: Blitz the pineapple in a blender with the banana, lime juice and 50ml cold water until smooth.
Fill a tall glass with ice, if you like, pour over the smoothie and serve immediately.
